description: We are a collaborative team of young students passionate about science and creativity. We are building a project that turns complex space mission planning and resource management into an engaging strategy game.
summary:
Our project is an interactive Space Mission Design Game that allows players to experience the challenges of planning and designing a space mission. Players choose from different mission objectives, select spacecraft equipment and scientific instruments, and make decisions about power sources, mass, and budget. Each choice involves tradeoffs that influence the design and outcome of the mission.

Our game addresses the challenge by turning the process of space mission planning into an engaging, hands on learning experience. Instead of just learning about spacecraft and space exploration, players actively make engineering decisions and see how different constraints affect their mission. By introducing concepts such as resource management, scientific instrumentation, and mission design, we hope to make space exploration more accessible and encourage curiosity about the science and engineering behind real NASA missions.
details:
Our project is an interactive Space Mission Design Game that introduces players to the process of planning and designing a space mission. Players begin by selecting a mission objective. Then they make decisions about spacecraft design, including selecting scientific instruments, choosing a power source, and allocating resources. Throughout the game, players must work within constraints such as budget, spacecraft mass, and power requirements. Their decisions influence the outcome of their mission.

The goal of the project is to make the science and engineering behind space exploration more approachable through interactive learning. Instead of reading about spacecraft design, players get to experiment with different designs, consider engineering tradeoffs, and see how their decisions affect a mission. We hope this encourages curiosity about space science and helps players develop an appreciation for the complexity of real world NASA missions.

Our project takes a creative, game-based approach to mission planning by combining scientific concepts with interactive decision-making. We designed it to balance educational content with an engaging experience, keeping the instructions and choices accessible to players who may have little prior knowledge of space exploration. In developing the game, we considered mission objectives, scientific accuracy, available spacecraft technologies, resource limitations, and the importance of making each choice meaningful.

We developed the game as an interactive website using Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript. These programming languages allowed us to build the game's interactive features and support the decision making and resource management aspects of gameplay.
